description:
Responsibilities Required Skills / Experience    
 Overall 5 to 7 years of report development and BI platform experience combined with 3-4 years of Tableau platform experience.
 Experiences in planning and delivering enterprise-wide BI, analytics, performance management and data warehouse solution using proven solution delivery methodology frameworks and best practices.
 hands-on design and implementation of enterprise BI, analytics and performance management solutions in a complex enterprise environment. · Working knowledge and experiences in data design / dimensional data modeling.
 Desired Skills / Experience         
 Working knowledge and experiences in Essbase cube and metadata model design and management.
 Working knowledge and experiences in data design / dimensional data modeling.
 Excellent communication skills
 Working knowledge and experiences in developing and deploying Dashboard, Analytics/OLAP, and performance management solutions.
 Working knowledge and experiences in ETL/Data integration with commercial tools


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
